entities.name: Query protein 161 aa

Sequence-derived instability index is 20.847 and GRAVY is -0.0764.

entities.name: cPMP synthesis RHEA:49580
observations: Catalyzes conversion of (8S)-3',8-cyclo-7,8-dihydroguanosine 5'-triphosphate to cyclic pyranopterin monophosphate, with diphosphate release.

entities.name: Molybdopterin biosynthesis
